plan: A rainy, run-down shed yard framed by roller shutters along the north edge and one on the east edge, with metal racks along the west edge. The focal point is the leak zone at the island centre (about 5,4.5): stacked red and grey plastic crates stand next to a dusty wooden broom, dustpan, watering can and trash can catching drips. Around it sit a cleaning-supply cart and racks in the NW, a wooden crate and storage-bin cluster in the NE/E, and planters, compost bags and chairs along the south. A 1-2 m walkway runs from the south spawn straight north to the crates.

The focal point is a red metal tool chest on the north edge at (5,1). It holds a row of three lanterns and is flanked by two tall industrial lamps, with more tool chests on either side and more lanterns and a gilt picture frame on top. Along the west edge is the workbench zone: two tool carts full of tools and lamps, plus a welding cart. Along the east edge is a festive gift row of treasure chests topped with lanterns, followed by a third tool cart. In the middle is a gift chest topped with lanterns. The south edge has gift chests and lamp posts. A walkway about 3m wide runs from the spawn point on the south edge north to the focal tool chest.

A brick factory facade corner frames the NW of the island. The focal point is the welding station at the center: a portable welding cart and an industrial table holding bolt cutters and torches. Workbenches line the edges: a north bench with a vice and drill press, a NE tool bench with a tool chest, an east bench with rolling tool chests, a west bench with a drill press, and a south coffee and chalkboard break corner. A 1-2 m open walkway loops around the central welding area, and the player spawns in the SW looking north-east at the sparks.

environment.ambient: busy industrial workshop, welding sparks and hum

plan: This is a leaky shed. Its focal point is a leaning stack of red and grey plastic crates in the middle, near (5, 4.6), sitting right under the roof drip. A dusty wooden broom, a dustpan and a rusted can catch the water around the stack, and a monobloc chair faces it. Roller-shutter windows form the north wall. Three metal shelving racks full of cleaning bottles line the west edge. The east edge holds a storage cart, bins and trash cans. Planters, compost bags and wooden crates run along the south edge. A 1 m walkway loops around the centre, and the player spawns on the open south side looking north at the crates.

The shed wall runs along the north edge: three roller shutters with two low potting shelves in front of them. The rusty chainlink fence and gate run down the east edge, with the garden hose, sprinkler and a spare watering can beside it. The focal point is the potting bench in the center (Desk03). It holds seedling trays, the watering can the gardener is grabbing, a trowel, gloves and pots, and a second worktable with a bench vice sits just to its east. Planter boxes with shrubs line the west edge, compost bags and big potted plants line the south edge, and 1 m walkways circle the bench so the player spawns in the open south-center looking north at it.

environment.mood: busy fresh garden shed morning, soft low sunlight

plan: Two L-shaped brick factory facade bases with cornices frame the northwest and southeast corners. The focal point is the welding station in the middle: a portable welding cart stands in front of a heavy welding table covered in bolt cutters, torches and pliers. The north edge holds a row of workbenches (metal office desk with drill press, second bench, tool chest), and the east edge has a big bench with a drill press and a vice. The southwest is a break and utility corner with a coffee cart, chalkboard, parts tables and a low tool bench. A second welding cart and stacked tool chests sit near the south. The player spawns at the south, looking north down a clear walkway along x=5 to the welding station.

A cramped night-time tool shed on a 10×10 plank floor. Worn nightstands stand in rows along the north, west, east and south edges as makeshift shelving. Their tops hold unlit spare lanterns, sconces, bulbs and old fittings. The focal point is a single blue nightstand in the middle of the room with a pull-chain porcelain socket and one bare bulb on top, the only light source. The trowel and dustpan lean against the north wall in a gap between the shelves. Old fluorescent tubes and a caged fixture lie on the floor by the south wall. A 1 m+ walkway runs around the centre, and the spawn point on the south side looks north at the bulb.

environment.mood: dim shed lit by a single bare bulb

plan: The north edge is the sagging shed's front wall: a graffiti-covered broken roller-shutter window sits in the middle as the focal point, with cement bags stacked in a pile on each side, a green metal rack and a leaning ladder beside them. The west edge holds old storage (bookshelf, shelf, a rusted bed frame and a step ladder), and the east edge is closed off by a rusted chainlink fence with a latch gate and a second metal rack. The south edge has a workshop cart covered in tools with a stool in front, plus crates, a bin and trash bags. The open center is scattered with dead branches, boxes and debris, and the player spawns south-west looking north at the broken window.

The shed is framed by rows of old nightstands used as workbenches and shelves along the north, west and east edges. Tall floor lamps stand in the corners like posts. A worn blue nightstand in the center holds the only lit fixture: a pull-chain socket with a bare bulb. The trowel and dustpan lean against the north wall in a gap between the benches. The benches are cluttered with spare bulbs, sconces, lanterns and fluorescent tubes. The south half is left as an open walkway, with a small cluster of storage in the southwest corner and a lantern pile in the southeast. The player starts at the south edge looking north at the bulb.

The focal point is the worn grey workbench in the middle of the island (x5, z4). A hand plane, handsaw, hacksaw, hammer, pliers and a lantern rest on it, with a stool in front and a drill press and red tool chest on either side. Storage frames the space: bookshelves, green metal racks, a sideboard, a tool cart and a tool chest line the north edge. The west edge has a vice table and a painted bench, and the east edge has a rack, a bookshelf and a nightstand. Mossy rocks sit in three corners, and a picnic table in the south makes a break area. Open walkways about 1 m wide or more circle the bench, and the player spawns in the southwest looking at it.

Along the north, west, east and south edges, green metal racks, red tool chests and drill presses face inward to frame the workshop. In the middle, four tool chests are pushed together back to back to make a central workbench. This is the focal point: the bench vice and the hanging industrial lamp sit on it, with wrenches, pliers and screwdrivers scattered across the top. A clear walkway at least 1 m wide rings the bench, and the player spawns on the open south side looking north at it.

environment.lighting: dim warm lamp light, dark night sky

plan: The north edge is the shed front: a row of roller shutters, a wall-mounted hose, and compost bags against it, with the main potting bench (Desk03) in the NW holding trays, tools and a vice. A chain-link fence with a gate runs down the east edge, lined with potted plants and anthuriums. Planter boxes line the south edge. A second potting table on the west is packed with seedling trays and a watering can. The focal point is a low bench in the centre where a watering can and seedling trays wait to be grabbed. Walkways run around the centre, and the spawn point on the south side looks north at that bench.

The workshop sits on a rainy afternoon. Two roller shutters line the north edge like a back wall, with a garden hose and gutter pieces beside them. The focal point is a green tool cart in front of the shutters, where the dripping pipe wrench and old crowbar lie next to a vice, pliers, hammer and pipe lamp, with a second cart of hand tools beside it. Drill presses, tool chests and a welding cart run along the west edge, planter boxes with garden tools stand along the east edge, and a third tool cart forms a centre workbench. Gutters, pipes and storage fill the south edge, and walkways about 1m wide circle the centre bench, with spawn in the open south-centre area facing the focal cart.

environment.lighting: dim diffuse daylight, warm lamp glow

plan: A dusty abandoned workshop. The focal point is a silent old drill press standing in the middle of the floor beside a red tool chest topped by a rusted olive toolbox. Storage lines the north and west edges: racks, tool carts and chests cluttered with tins, saws, vices and blowtorches. A covered car sits in the west-center, and a rusted chainlink fence with a latched gate frames the east edge beside a second tool station. Mossy rocks and bark debris creep in along the south, with an open walkway from the south-center spawn north to the drill press.

environment.description: Abandoned workshop coated in dust, dim hazy light

plan: The focal point is a worn grey metal workbench in the center of the island at (5, 4.5). It holds the hand plane, a handsaw, a vice, a hammer, pliers, a hacksaw and a lantern, with a stool in front, a tool chest to its west and a nightstand with a hand drill to its east. Tall shelving and racks line the north edge, with storage along the west and east edges to frame the space. The southern part has a picnic-table break area in the southwest and mossy rocks in the southeast. Open walkways run through the center and south, and the player starts at the south edge looking north at the bench through the dawn fog.

The focal point is a work cart along the north edge. It's flanked by a drill press and a tool chest on the west side, and a welding cart, LPG tank and masonry heater on the east side. Neat stacks of crates line the west edge, with a display shelf beside them, and three ladders stand against the east edge. The centre has a cozy seating spot: a coffee table with a lantern and a propane torch on it and two crates to sit on. A barrel cluster, log stacks, a barrel stove, planters and a spinning wheel frame the south edge. Walkways about 1m wide run around the central table, and the player spawns on the south side looking north at the workbench.

The island is framed by a rusted chainlink fence on the north and east edges and a fallen roller shutter on the south edge. The focal point sits on the north side: a silent old green drill press next to a rusted red tool chest with an olive toolbox on top. Workbench carts covered in tools line the northwest, dusty metal racks stand against the west and east edges, an industrial storage cart holds a blowtorch and tins, and a covered car rests in the southeast next to a leaning ladder. Mossy rocks and bark debris show nature creeping in from the southwest, and a 1m walkway runs through the center from the spawn point to the drill press.

The focal point is a central workbench built from four red tool chests pushed back to back at about (5,5). It holds a bench vice, wrenches, pliers, a hand drill and a pipe lamp, with a hanging industrial lamp above it and a few wrenches dropped on the floor around it. Storage lines all four edges: green racks, tool chests with a second vice, and drill presses on the north, west, east and south sides, each facing inward. A smaller drill-press station sits in the southeast. There is a 1 m walkway loop around the central bench, and the open southwest corner is the spawn point, facing the bench.

environment.sky: dark night sky with faint stars
environment.mood: cluttered workshop at night, warm pools of light from industrial lamps

plan: The focal point is a graffiti-covered roller-shutter 'broken window' in the middle of the north edge. Stacks of worn cement bags sit on both sides of it, with a spilled crate and a ladder nearby. The west edge is framed by rusty chainlink fence with a dead quiver trunk and branches. The east edge has sagging shelves, a rack, and a storage cart used as a workbench with tools on top and a stool in front. The south edge holds an old bed frame, compost bags, a bin, trash and a crate. Walkways stay open through the centre and down the middle to the spawn point on the south side, which looks north at the window.

The focal point is on the north edge: a red metal tool chest with three lanterns on top. Folding ladders stand on each side of it with wooden lanterns on top, like a string of lights, and two industrial lamp posts light the ends. Low brick factory bases frame the northwest and southeast corners, and holiday lanterns line their tops. The workshop groups sit against the edges: a tool cart on the north edge, a welding cart and two gift-like treasure chests on the east, a storage row with a Chinese chandelier on the south, and a small storage wall on the west. A central workbench cart and a tool chest stand to the left of a clear 1.5 m north–south walkway at x≈6. The player spawns at the south end of that walkway, looking at the decorated chest.

The north edge is the workbench wall. It has an industrial cart used as the main bench with a vice, saw, hand drill and propane torch, plus a welding cart, a tool chest, a drill press, a stack of logs and a masonry heater in the NE corner. The east edge holds the neatly stacked crates in rows: green military crates stacked two high, towers of plastic crates, wooden chests and a pair of barrels. The west edge has a shelf and the two ladders, with a crate stack and barrels in the SW corner. The south edge has more crates, a planter and a spinning wheel. The focal point is a pair of industrial tables in the middle with torches, a lantern and small tins, with crate stools beside them and a barrel stove nearby. You start at the south and look north toward the center tables, with open walkways around them.

A fenced shed interior framed on all four edges, with a latched door in the middle of the south wall. Garden gloves, a coiled hose and a caged wall lamp hang beside and above the door. The focal point is a central potting bench made of two planter boxes, lit by a hanging brass chandelier and lanterns. The Scandinavian heater warms the NE corner, and planter-box workbenches with tools and lanterns line the west, north and east walls. A 1m+ walkway rings the center bench, and the spawn point sits just inside the door looking north.

A rain-soaked open-air workshop framed by roller shutters along the north and west edges. The focal point is the north workbench, a green tool cart holding the pipe wrench, old crowbar, vice and lamp, with a second parts cart and two drill presses beside it. The east edge holds the welding station, a tool chest and a cluster of dripping upright pipes. The south edge has planters, a drainage gutter and baskets, and the west edge has a wall hose and leaning garden tools. A center cart with a toolbox sits in the middle, with 1m+ walkways all around it; the player spawns at the south side looking north at the main bench.

This is a snug shed interior. Rusted chainlink fence panels run along the north and west edges, and the door with its latch sits in the southwest corner. The garden hose hangs next to the door with a pair of gloves draped on it, and a planter box beside it holds more gloves and a trowel. The focal point is the Scandinavian masonry heater at the north-center, with floor lamps and wooden lanterns placed around it. Along the east wall, planter boxes serve as a potting bench covered with lanterns, tools and a dartboard. The south wall has more planter boxes with a gnome and lanterns, plus a cluster of pots and a lamp in the corner. The middle of the floor is left open as a walkway between the door, the heater and the benches.

environment.lighting: warm dim lantern glow, amber tones

plan: The shed front runs along the north edge. It's a row of roller-shutter windows and doors, and the open arched castle door at x≈5.3 is the focal doorway. The path in front of it stays clear. Wicker baskets and compost bags are piled on both sides of the doorway. A rusty chainlink fence runs along the east edge, with a storage cart against it holding seedling trays and tools, plus a chair and a crate cluster nearby. Planter boxes line the west and south edges, and a picnic table with chairs in the southwest holds potting supplies. The player starts at the south-centre with open ground ahead, looking north at the sunny doorway.

The focal point is a wooden pier on the east edge. Next to its landward edge sit the fisherman's hat, a woven basket standing in for the coiled rope (there is no rope model), a compass, buckets and a lantern. A tall red sea marker frames the northeast corner, and a buoy and lifebuoy sit in the southeast. Along the north edge a chainlink fence backs a cargo line of barrels and hay bales with lanterns, baskets and tools on top. On the west side a harbor cannon points toward the pier, with rocks in the southwest, and more hay cargo and barrels fill the south. A 2–3 m open walkway runs east to west through the middle from the spawn point to the pier.

The shed front runs along the north edge, with roller-shutter windows and a side shutter door on either side of a large wooden double door at x≈5.2. Compost bags and wicker baskets are piled on both sides of that door, and a 1.8 m gap is left clear in front of it. Planter boxes with seedling trays line the west edge, and a chainlink fence with planters frames the east edge. In the middle of the south half, a picnic table with chairs holds garden clutter, and the south edge has more planters, bags, crates and a storage cart. You start in the open southwest area, looking north at the shed door.

environment.ground: grass with packed dirt near the shed

plan: Weathered pier pole sections run along the east edge like the end of the dock, and a tall rusted sea marker stands in the southeast corner. The focal point is a dead-wood mooring post at (6.8, 4.5): the rusted fish knife lies beside it on the ground, with a lifebuoy, a bucket and a can nearby. A workshop row with a rack, tool chest, drill press and crate benches lines the north edge. There is a barrel and crate stack on the west edge, fishing clutter and an ocean buoy along the south, and a small crate table with a barrel seat in the middle. The walkway runs west to east through z 4 to 5 from the spawn to the post.

environment.ground: weathered grey wooden planks with damp moss
environment.ambient_sound: soft creaking wood, lapping water, distant gulls

plan: The weathered lateral sea marker in the NE corner is the focal point, standing over the dark water. A three-bay wooden pier of pilings runs along the south edge, lit by two cast-iron street lamps with lanterns along its landward lip. The west edge is framed by a chainlink fence, with a buoy and lantern cluster behind it. Lifebuoys hang along the north edge, and a searchlight lookout in the centre-east points at the marker. Spawn is on the west side with an open walkway running east toward the marker.

environment.ground: weathered wet wooden planks and dark stone
environment.water: dark calm ocean surrounding the island

plan: The focal point sits at the island's center: a stack of wooden crates and a green military crate around (5,5), with a rusted red jerrycan standing in front of it as if in a puddle on the wet asphalt. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge. The west edge has shelving, a storage cart and a cluster of barrels. The east edge has trash cans, a timber stack and more crates. Concrete barriers line the south edge. Walkways about 1 m wide loop around the central stack, and the player starts in the southwest looking northeast at it.

environment.ground: wet cracked asphalt with reflective rain puddles
environment.lighting: cold diffuse overcast light, glossy wet reflections

plan: A fenced night storage yard. Chain-link fence runs along the north and west edges, with a latch gate in the southwest corner, and a row of roller-shuttered storage bays lines the east edge. The focal point is a tall 6m lamp pole with a security light on top, near the centre, so the fence and the stacked barriers cast long shadows. Around it are four groups: a stacked concrete-barrier stockpile to the north, a guard's nightstand with a searchlight to the northeast, spare fence panels and an old iron gate stored to the west, and a line of barriers along the south edge. A 1m walkway loops around the pole, and the player spawns on the south side looking north at the light.

environment.sky: clear night, dark blue with stars
environment.lighting: single harsh security light, strong long shadows, cold white key light, deep dark surroundings

plan: The whole island is a weathered plank dock. Two tall pier-pole sections stand along the east edge as mooring posts, and the focal point is the gap between them, where the rusted fish knife lies beside the posts next to a lantern, a rusty can and a bucket. A huge red sea marker fills the southeast corner. Storage lines the north edge (metal rack, a barrel cluster, stacked crates and a red tool chest), the west edge has a makeshift work crate with a vice and saw plus a drill press and toolbox, and the south edge has crates, buckets, a lifebuoy and an ocean buoy. Staves, a wheel rim and dead wood lie scattered around the open middle, which stays clear as a walkway from the spawn toward the posts.

environment.ambient: soft creaking wood, lapping water, gulls

plan: The focal point is a cluster of half-buried military crates in the center (around x 4-6, z 5-6.5), ringed with weeds. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the north and west edges, with a gate latch on the west side. Along the north fence stand metal racks and an industrial cart with cans and tools on them. Along the west side are an abandoned bed frame, a tool chest and a compressor. Trash cans, plastic crates, a planter and stacked crates line the east edge, and concrete barriers close off the south. Walkways about 1 m wide loop between these zones, and the player spawns near the west gate looking northeast at the crates.

environment.ground: patchy dirt and gravel with dry grass

plan: The south edge is the water's edge. Wooden pier pilings stand in the SW corner, a tall lateral sea marker in the SE corner, and the focal point sits between them: a red ocean buoy with a stack of old military and wooden crates, barrels and a lifebuoy beside it. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge, with a storage row of crates, barrels and boxes in front of it. Big shoreline rocks with dry driftwood line the east side, and a storage cart with a stool and a crate seat forms a small workspace on the west side. The open centre, marked by a manhole cover and lit by a street lamp, is the walkway. The player starts near the north fence looking south at the buoy through the morning fog.

environment.ground: weathered wooden planks and damp concrete

plan: The focal point is a stack of crates in the centre at about (4.5-5.3, 4.5-4.8). A rusted red jerrycan and a rusted can sit in front of it on wet asphalt with puddles. Rusted chainlink fence runs along most of the north edge, with plastic and wooden crate stacks in front of it. Two metal racks in the NE corner and a steel cart on the east edge hold oil tins and spray cans. The west edge has a cluster of barrels and jerrycans plus two trash cans. The east side has military crates and drums, and the south edge has concrete barriers, a log pile and a hydrant. A 1 m walkway loops around the centre stack, and you start at the south edge looking north at it across open wet ground.

environment.ground: wet cracked dark asphalt with many shallow reflective rain puddles
environment.lighting: dim diffuse grey light, glossy wet reflections

plan: Night storage yard. A row of roller-shutter storage unit doors runs along the north edge, with security lights, cameras and sconces mounted on top. Chain-link fencing closes the east and south edges and has a gate latch section, and an iron gate frames the west side. The focal point is a cast-iron street lamp in the center of the yard with clusters of stacked concrete barriers around it. A tall street lamp in the southeast corner throws long fence shadows. A guard nightstand with a searchlight sits by the west entry, and walkways stay open in front of the shutters and through the middle.

environment.sky: clear night, dark blue with faint stars
environment.mood: cold sodium and white security lighting, long hard shadows

plan: The glowing red lateral sea marker is the focal point, standing alone in the NE corner (8.4,1.6) above the dark water, with three ocean buoys along the east edge beside it. The south edge is a weathered pier made of three piling sections, lit by a cast-iron street lamp at its eastern end. A chainlink fence and a lifebuoy frame the west edge. A lantern-lit lookout group (searchlight, signal flashlight, compass and lanterns) faces the marker from the middle-north area. Rows of lanterns and oil lamps line the pier front, the fence and the north edge, leaving an open 1-2 m walkway through the center from the spawn point to the marker.

environment.sky: clear dark night sky with faint stars and a thin moon
environment.surroundings: dark calm ocean water around the island

plan: A fenced storage-yard corner has been turned into a break area. Chainlink fence runs along the north edge, with a cluster of wooden and steel barrels in the NE corner. Storage racks and carts line the west edge, and concrete road barriers plus a utility box line the east edge. The focal point is in the center: a wine barrel used as a table, with the folding stool right beside it, a rusty barrel stove and a couple of spare stools. A vintage sofa on the west side faces the barrel. The south edge has a lounge nook (leather sofa, lounge chair, coffee table), a chalkboard, and a café table set next to a planter. Walkways about 1 m wide loop around the center, and the player spawns at the south-center edge looking north at the barrel.

The water's edge is the south side. The focal point sits there at center-south: a red ocean buoy next to a stacked old military crate with a plastic crate on top. A tall lateral sea marker frames the southwest corner and the pier pilings frame the southeast. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge. Storage groups line the edges: barrels and a storage cart on the west, crate stacks on the east, barrels by the pier. In the middle there's a small crate-table with stools and a street lamp, and there are 1 m walkways between them all the way from the north spawn to the buoy.

A foggy storage yard framed by a chainlink fence along the north and east edges. The focal point is a rusty barrel stove in the center-east with crate seats around it. The northwest holds a wine barrel cellar-yard cluster, the northeast has stacked plastic storage bins, and a service cart stands against the east fence. The west edge has compost bags and trash, mossy rocks and a concrete barrier line close the south side, and metal and plastic drums fill the southeast. Walkways about 1 m wide run north-south at x≈3.5–4.5 and east-west at z≈2.5–3.5 and z≈6–7. The player spawns near the south edge looking north into the mist at the stove.

The focal point is a rusty barrel stove near the island centre at (5.2, 5.0). It is ringed by seats: a folding stool beside an upright wooden barrel used as a side table, a wine barrel, a Chinese stool and two small stools. A chainlink fence runs along the north and west edges. The storage-yard stock is grouped in clusters: wooden barrels in the NW corner, metal racks and a storage cart along the north fence, blue drums in the NE, and a tool cart, generators, a utility box, a ladder and concrete barriers down the east side. The break area is dressed around this with a sofa lounge on the west side, a cafe table and chalkboard in the SW, and planters plus a bench along the south edge. The player spawns at the south centre, where about 2 m of open walkway leads north to the stove.

A chainlink fence and a row of steel shelving units run along the north edge. The west side holds stacks of wooden and military crates, then wooden barrels, logs and a chest in the southwest corner. Oil drums and LPG tanks are packed together in the northeast, with a tool cart and tool chest on the east edge. The south edge has bins, compost bags and crate stacks. The focal point is a tall stack of military crates in the center, and there is a second crate pile south of it. Open walkways, 1–2 m wide, run around the central stacks.

The focal point is a hand truck loading a red drum near the center of the yard (about 3.2,4). A second hand truck to the east is being loaded with a blue drum, and a few staged drums and a crate stack sit nearby. The north edge is framed by steel shelving and a row of drums. The east edge has a working line of carts (storage cart, tool cart, welding cart, coffee cart) with a barrel stove break spot. The west edge holds dense clusters of metal and wooden barrels, and the south edge holds a wall of crate stacks, plastic bins, compost bags and timber. Walkways of about 1 m run around the central work area, and the player spawns in the southeast, looking northwest at the hand truck.

A chain-link fence and a row of steel shelving run along the north edge. Stacked wooden and military crates fill the west side, an oil drum field with LPG tanks and a parts cart covers the east, and a south strip holds a tool chest, bins, logs, compost bags and plastic crates. The focal point is a stacked military-crate pile ringed by drums at the island center (5,5). One-meter walkways run around it and along x≈2.5–3.5 and x≈6.5–8, and the player spawns at the south-center looking north at the pile.

A foggy fenced storage yard. A chainlink fence frames the north and west edges, with a latched gate on the west side. The focal point is a rusted barrel stove at the center (4.5,5), ringed by crates used as seats and piles of firewood. Wine barrels line the north fence two rows deep, some stacked, with bottles on top. Plastic storage bins and industrial containers are stacked along the east edge and the northwest corner. The southeast holds a storage cart with cleaning supplies plus a drum cluster, and the southwest holds concrete barriers, compost bags and a mossy rock. Open 1m+ walkways run from the west gate east past the stove and north-south through the middle.

The focal point is a half-buried pile of old military crates in the middle of the yard at about (5,5), with weeds growing around it and on it. A smaller second crate group with jerrycans sits to the southeast. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the north and west edges. The north edge is a storage row: metal racks, a tool chest with a hacksaw, a storage cart, a compressor and a trash can. Concrete barriers close off the east and south edges. Other groups: a stack of wooden and plastic crates in the southwest, a planter and a watering can in the east, and a discarded bed frame in the southeast. Walkways loop around the central pile, and the player starts at the south, looking north at the crates.

environment.ground: dry cracked dirt with patchy grass

plan: The east edge is a wooden pier made from two sets of pilings, with the water past them. The focal point is at the pier's edge (x≈7.3, z≈5.5): a fisherman's hat lies on the planks next to a lifebuoy with its loose coiled rope, and a barrel and buckets sit beside them. A brick factory corner frames the northwest. Clustered barrels, buckets, a hay bale and an old cannon along the north and centre make up the busy working harbour, with small tools, lanterns and baskets on top. A tall red sea marker, buoys, a chainlink fence along the south edge, and rocks along the west edge close in the rest. Clear walkways run north–south at x≈2.5 and x≈5–7, and east–west at z≈2 and z≈7.

environment.ground: weathered wooden planks and damp stone
environment.ambience: busy harbor, gulls and lapping water

plan: A walled storage yard: a stone fort gate wall runs along the west edge, steel shelving and a storage cart line the north edge, and tool, welding and stove stations with a row of drums sit along the east edge. At the center is the focal point: a hand truck being loaded with barrels, next to a crate set down in the yard. Crate stacks fill the south-center and north-center, and a dense barrel cluster fills the southeast corner. A coffee cart break spot faces the yard from the wall, and 1m walkways run between the groups. The player spawns in the open northeast area looking at the hand truck.

This is a dockside platform. A row of guardrails runs along the north edge, with lifebuoys hanging on the rail and an ocean buoy in the NE corner. In front of the rail, a red painted bench faces south with two thermoses and a compass on it; this is the focal point. A modern street bench sits to the west and a picnic table to the east. The middle has a small café table set and a lounge chair. Along the east edge are a storage cart and industrial pipes, and a few pipes stand in the NW. Concrete barriers line the west edge and the south edge, with pier pilings in the SW and SE corners. A 1-2 m walkway runs east-west at z≈2.5-3.5 and north-south down the centre to the spawn point in the south.

environment.sky: warm golden evening with soft clouds

plan: The focal point is a Chinese tea table at the centre (5,4.8), set with a tea service and flanked by two lidded ceramic pots. Three turquoise display tables line the north edge as the main stall, holding ceramic vases, a tea-set counter and a brass-ware counter. Two nightstands with lanterns sit at the north corners. Along the west edge, three nightstands hold single vases. On the east side, a round marble table and a long display table show tea sets and vases. In the southwest, two cafe table-and-chair sets serve as a tasting area. Potted plants and clay planters fill the corners. The south-centre strip and a 1 m ring around the tea table are left open as walkways, and the player spawns in the south-centre facing the tea table.

environment.lighting: low golden sun with warm lantern glow

plan: The dock's south edge is lined with guardrails, and the one at the southeast is knocked askew. Right behind it are the focal pieces: the red ocean buoy and a group of barrels, with a wooden lantern sitting on one barrel. The pier poles (topped with a wall lamp) stand in the northwest, two cannons aim out to sea on the north edge, and a tall lateral sea marker fills the northeast corner. A dense cargo pile of barrels and staves runs along the west edge, and a concrete barrier plus a guardrail frame the east. A 1-2 m walkway through the middle leads from the spawn point in the west to the buoy.

environment.lighting: dim, cold blue with warm lantern glow

plan: An L-shaped factory building corner sits in the northwest. Highway sound-barrier panels line the north edge, a rusted chainlink fence with a gate runs down the east edge, and concrete road barriers close off the west and south, so the space reads as a fenced alley. The focal point is a tall pile of stacked plastic crates and bins just east of the building corner. A street rat scurries past its front, with a second rat nosing through trash bags south of the building. There are smaller crate stacks by the east fence and in the middle of the alley, a streetlamp by the fence, and an open walkway through the center from the spawn point in the south.

The focal point is a weathered ocean buoy near the centre (5.5, 4.3). Beside it, just to the south, a battered guardrail sits knocked askew at 20°. A tall stone seawall frames the west edge. The big lateral sea marker stands in the NE corner, and pier pilings in the SE hold a hanging lantern chandelier that swings in the storm. Guardrails line the north and south edges. Clusters of barrels hold scattered lanterns, a compass and a flashlight: one cluster in the SW, one on the east side with a concrete barrier, and one in the north beside a checkered barrier and a cannon aimed north. The player spawns on open ground in the SE, looking NW at the buoy, with walkways around the buoy and between the clusters.

environment.sound: crashing waves, wind, creaking wood, clanging buoy bell

plan: A narrow north-south alley. The west edge is a building frontage: roller shutters and a heavy arched door at the middle (x0.3, z5), which is the focal point. A broom and dustpan lean beside the door, with a stacked cluster of wooden barrels just south of it. A chainlink fence frames the east edge, and in front of it sit a stove-and-bench warm-up corner (NE), a cluster of metal and plastic drums (mid), and a log pile (SE). A concrete barrier closes the north end, and a row of drums lines the south edge. A 4 m wide open walkway down the centre (x 2.5–7.5) holds only scattered bark debris.

environment.sky: soft pale pink and orange dawn sky, low sun
environment.ambient: quiet, cool light with long shadows

plan: A narrow night alley in the rain, with the path running north to south. Roller-shutter storefronts line the west edge, and a highway sound wall with green utility boxes runs along the east edge. Concrete barriers close off the north end. The focal point is the lit cast-iron street lamp on the east side, whose light shines on the wet pavement and a manhole cover in the middle of the alley. Soaked cardboard boxes and crates are piled against both walls. A 3–4 m wet walkway runs down the middle from the spawn point at the south end.

environment.ground: wet asphalt with puddles, glossy reflective
environment.lighting: warm sodium street lamp glow reflecting on wet pavement, cool blue ambient

plan: The island is a narrow alley. Chain-link fences run along the west, east and north edges, and two strands of hanging bulbs stretch across the alley between the fence tops at z=3 and z=6.5. Under the first strand, a folding stool sits with a small lantern-lit table in front of it in the north center; that is the focal point. Around it are four groups: a Chinese sofa lounge in the northwest, a café table in the northeast, a day bed with a nightstand on the west side, and a bench with stools on the east side. A small bar table with chairs and a street bench sit along the south edge. A 1 m walkway runs down the middle from the south-edge spawn to the nook.

Market display tables line the north edge: two turquoise vintage tables with rows of ceramic and brass vases, plus a Chinese tea table with a lidded pot, all framed by large potted plants in the corners. Nightstands against the west and east edges carry lanterns and more vases, and a ceramic pot stands on the ground next to each row. The focal point is a round marble tasting table in the center with a full tea service. In the south are two small sitting areas: a tea table and a lantern nightstand in the southwest, and an outdoor cafe set in the southeast. A 1 m walkway runs around the center table, and the player starts at the south edge looking north toward it.

environment.lighting: low golden sun with warm lantern glow

plan: The north edge is the waterfront: a guardrail runs along it with the lifebuoy hanging on it, and a red painted bench faces the water with a thermos and compass on it. That bench is the focal point, with a lounge chair next to it and a tall lateral sea marker in the NE corner. The picnic area in the center, the gear cart and pipe workshop on the east, and the storage cart, bench seating and chainlink fence on the south edge give the dock its lived-in feel. A 1 m walkway runs east-west around z≈3.3 and north-south at x≈6.5–7.

The coffee cart is the focal point at the island's center (5,3.5), facing south toward the spawn. Two roller-shutter shopfronts frame the north edge and a chainlink fence lines the west edge. Covered basket stalls, made of four tables laden with lidded and open baskets, sit along the west and east edges. Two small industrial tables south of the cart form a standing coffee spot, and barrel clusters, carts, compost bags, boots and concrete barriers fill the corners, leaving a wide central north-south walkway and 1 m aisles beside each stall.

A narrow abandoned alley runs north-south. Roller shutters line the west wall, a rusted chainlink fence runs along the east edge, and concrete barriers block both the north and south ends. The focal point is the weathered green utility box cluster on the west wall at z≈7-9, buried in a pile of trash bags. Two rusty trash cans sit by the shutters, and a derelict workshop dump (rack, carts, tool chest, tyres) lines the fence. The central strip x≈2.5-7.5 stays mostly open as a littered walkway, and the player spawns in the south-east looking west at the utility boxes.

An alley nook framed by chainlink fence along the north and west edges, with a raised stoop platform against the east edge. The focal point is a small folding stool tucked against the north fence near (4.8,2.2), with a side table and lanterns beside it and two strands of bulb sockets strung overhead at 2.4 m. Around it sit a cafe table set in the southwest, a bench and nightstand along the south edge, and a stool cluster on and beside the east stoop. An open walkway runs through the center from the south spawn point up to the stool.

environment.lighting: warm, low ambient with glowing bulbs

plan: The focal point is a foggy alley corner. A brick factory facade stands at the NW corner, concrete highway sound walls run along the north and west edges, and a rusted chainlink fence with a gate lines the east edge. In the middle, stacked plastic crates and a storage bin form the main group, and a street rat scurries west past them. Around it sit a trash-bag pile by the north wall, concrete barriers and blue bins along the fence, and bin and crate stacks along the south edge. Open 1–2 m walkways stay free between the groups, and you start in the southeast looking northwest at the crates.

A north-south market alley runs through the middle of the island (x 3.5–6.5), with an open walkway from the south spawn to a gated fence at the north end. The west side is lined with a chainlink fence and has stalls against it: a tool cart, a coffee cart, a storage cart, crates, barrels and bins, most with baskets and cheese boxes on top. The east side is backed by highway insulation walls and holds a second stall row with a treasure chest, tool chests, utility boxes, barrels and stacked crates. The focal point is the red hand truck in the middle of the alley next to a stack of plastic crates, and concrete barriers mark the south entrance.

A narrow north-south alley. A graffiti-streaked wall with roller shutters runs down the west edge, and a rusty chainlink fence with a gate lines the east edge. The focal point is on the west wall at z 4-6: three overflowing metal trash cans buried in black bags, watched by a wall-mounted CCTV camera, a flickering security light and a second camera on a pole across the alley. The central strip (x 2-8) stays open as a 1.5 m+ walkway. The east side holds dumped junk (tyres, compost bags, a discarded nightstand, jerrycans, another bin), and a row of concrete barriers blocks the south end. The player spawns at the open north end, looking down the alley at the trash cluster.

environment.sky: dark overcast night sky, faint city glow
environment.mood: grimy urban back alley, sodium lamp glow and a flickering security light

plan: A narrow north-south alley framed by tall sound-barrier walls on the west and east edges, closed at the north end by a rusty chainlink fence with a gate, and half-blocked at the south end by concrete barriers. The focal point is a cluster of overflowing trash cans and bags against the west wall around z 3.5-7, watched by a pole-mounted security camera. The east wall holds roller shutters, a camera, a security light, a hydrant and discarded junk: tyres, jerrycans and an old nightstand. A 3 m wide walkway runs down the centre (x 3-7) from the spawn at the south end to the fence gate.

A narrow north–south alley at night in the rain. Roller-shutter storefronts line the west and east edges, low road barriers close the north end, and a fence, barriers and a guardrail close the south end. The focal point is the wet centre of the pavement around a manhole with a wet-floor sign, lit by two cast-iron street lamps. Soaked cardboard-box piles, crates, utility boxes, planters and graffiti spray cans cluster along both walls, leaving a clear 3 m walkway down the middle.

environment.sky: overcast dark night sky with low clouds
environment.ground: wet dark asphalt with puddles and strong specular reflections
environment.lighting: warm sodium lamp light pooling on wet pavement, cool blue ambient

plan: This is a narrow north-south alley. Graffiti-covered roller shutters form a building wall along the west edge, a rusted chainlink fence runs down the east edge, and concrete road barriers block the north end. The focal point is the weathered green utility box against the east fence, with a smaller utility box and a power box beside it. Trash bags, boxes, crates, tyres and junk are piled along both walls. Rusted trash cans sit in the northeast corner, and carts and a tool chest line the south edge with tools and tins on top. A 3 m wide walkway (x 3–7) stays open down the middle, with a few stray cans and a bag in it, and the player starts at the south end looking up the alley.

A north-south market alley with a 1.5-3m walkway down the middle (x 3.5-6.5 and x 6-8.5). A concrete-panel wall frames the west edge and a chainlink fence the east. Vendor carts, crate stacks and baskets line both sides. The focal point is the rattling hand truck in mid-alley beside a stack of crates, with a crate display island just south of it. Barrels and trash bags crowd the SE corner, and the player spawns at the south end looking north up the alley.

A closed market stall on the north edge: shuttered roller doors form the backdrop, with a counter (Desk03) at the centre holding the locked cash register as the focal point. A side counter of stacked produce crates stands to its west and a chalkboard sits out front. A chain-link fence lines the west edge. The east edge holds a utility box, a display shelf, a storage cart and a tool chest. Crate stacks fill the SE and SW corners, and a small vendor rest nook sits mid-west. A clear central walkway runs from the south spawn up to the counter.

environment.lighting: dim sodium streetlight glow, quiet and still

plan: This is a narrow north-south alley at dawn. The west edge is a building wall made of roller shutters and an arched wooden door at (0.2, 5), which is the focal point. A wooden broom leans just north of the door, and two stacks of barrels plus a pile of loose staves sit just south of it. The east edge is framed by tall barrier walls with storage along them: drums, a barrel stove, a log stack and a low workbench with tools on it. A chainlink fence closes the north edge. Barrels, stacked logs and a street stall table with small items line the south edge. The middle of the alley (x 2–8) stays open as the walkway. The player starts on the east side and looks west at the doorway.

environment.sky: pale peach and soft blue dawn sky
environment.ground: worn cracked asphalt with damp patches

plan: The coffee cart stands at the island's centre (5,4) as the focal point, facing south toward the player, with steel drums behind it. A chainlink fence lines the north edge and a roller-shutter kiosk sits on the east edge. Covered market stalls on the west and south edges are old painted tables full of wicker baskets. Two workshop tables near the cart act as standing counters, and utility carts, barrels and compost bags fill the corners. A 1 m walkway loops around the cart, and the player starts at the open south gap looking north at the steaming cart.

environment.ambient: rain on tarps, distant chatter, hissing espresso steam

plan: The closed stall is at the north centre of the island. A counter (Desk03) holds the locked cash register and a few small items, with three lowered roller shutters behind it and a chainlink fence along the north and east edges. Crates and a produce table fill the west side. The east side has the storage cart, a utility box and a tool corner. A chalkboard stands in front of the stall facing the spawn point. The centre and south of the island stay open as a walkway to the counter.

The focal point is a painted farmhouse table in the middle of the island (5,5). Two planter boxes full of lemons sit on it, with loose lemons, a lime and a lantern between them. Market stalls line the edges: along the north are a coffee cart, a sideboard display, planter boxes and plants, with a street lamp at the northwest corner. The west side has a display shelf, a fruit table and planters. The east side has a produce table, a picnic seating area and planters, and the south has a small café table with two chairs and an outdoor table set. Walkways of about 1 m circle the centre table. You start at the south edge looking north at the lemon table.

The stone fire pit sits in the center of the island at (5,5). Four folding stools, two footstools and two wooden lanterns ring it tightly. Seating frames the fire on each side: a bench on the north side, a bench on the east edge, a table-and-chairs set on the west edge with wooden stools, and a table set between two benches along the south edge. Barrel stoves along the north edge form a cooking and warming area, and a metal stool with a lantern stands in each corner. Walkways about 1 m wide run around the fire ring, and the player spawns in the open southwest area looking at the fire.

An industrial brick corner wall frames the northwest corner. The focal fruit stand runs along the north edge: four compost-bag display tiers topped with wicker baskets and wooden bowls overflowing with kiwis, pomegranates and other fruit. A second display island sits in the center, and a checkout with a cash register is on the east side. Overflow stock sits by the wall and in two small southern groups, with desert shrubs and quiver trees dressing the southern corners and 1 m walkways running between all groups; the player spawns at the south edge looking north at the stand.

Two L-shaped brick facade corner pieces frame the north-west and north-east of the island as the market's back wall. The focal point is a stall counter made from a row of stacked compost bags across the middle (z≈5). Wicker baskets and wooden bowls sit on the counter, piled with kiwis, pomegranates, apples, avocados and citrus, and a cash register stands at the east end. A second row of baskets full of fruit sits on the ground in front, with a side display on the east edge. Quiver trees, rooibos bushes and potted succulents dress the corners. An open walkway runs along the south, where the player spawns looking north at the stall.

The main feature is a painted farmhouse market table in the middle of the island at (5, 4.8). Two planter boxes sit on it, with lemons piled between them and a small lemon crate, and a vendor stool stands behind it. A row of stalls lines the north edge between two street lamps: a coffee cart, a sideboard and a gingham dining table covered in more lemons and limes. The west edge has display shelves and planters; the east edge has small produce tables, planters and potted plants. The south edge has a picnic table, a chalkboard sign, a small café set and an ocean buoy for a harbor feel. A seedling table on the west side and a round lemon table on the east side complete a ring around the center. Walkways about 1 m wide go around the central table, and the spawn point is on the south side facing north toward it.

The glowing stone fire pit sits at the center of the island (5,5). Around it is a tight ring of seats: a folding stool with a wooden lantern beside it on the south side, a street bench on the north with lanterns on it, and wooden stools, a metal stool and a footstool. The NW corner is a heating nook with the masonry heater, a barrel stove and stools holding lanterns. The NE is a gear corner with the welding cart, a barrel stove, torches and a searchlight. The east edge and SW corner each have a café table set with lanterns on top. A grated platform along the south edge works as a raised deck with seating and lights, and the SE corner has a third barrel stove and more stools. A 1 m walkway loops around the fire ring, and the player spawns on the open west edge facing the fire.

The focal point is a stone fire pit at the island's center (5,5). Just north of it, a long dead tree trunk lies beside the rusted barrel stove, with firewood, bark scraps, a spade and loose barrel staves piled next to the stove. Chainlink fencing runs along the north edge and the upper west edge to frame the site. Around the fire pit, stumps and a log serve as seats. An old picnic table with rusted cans on it stands on the east side. Rusty drums and wooden barrels are grouped in the southeast and northeast corners, and tyres, a wheel rim and deadwood are scattered along the south and west edges. Walkways about 1 m wide loop around the fire ring, and the player starts at the south facing north toward the fire pit.

environment.ground: dry dirt with patchy dead grass

plan: The focal point is a stone fire pit in the middle of the island (5,5). Just north of it, a big dead tree trunk lies beside the rusted barrel stove, and a ring of stumps around the pit serves as seats. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the north and west edges, with a gate in the northeast. There are four groups: rusty and wooden barrels in the northeast, a littered picnic table in the southwest, a fallen trunk with old tyres in the southeast, and bark and branch debris scattered across the ground. The player starts at the south edge and looks north across an open 2 m path toward the fire pit, the trunk and the stove.

The stone fire pit sits at the center of the island (5,5.2) and is the focal point. Large mossy rocks and a big root cluster line the north edge, a fallen trunk runs along the west edge, and a rock with fir saplings frames the south. The woodpile is next to the fire: a log stack with dry branches on top just east of the pit, and a row of dry branches laid out just west of it. A second log stack and a rusty barrel stove sit against the east edge. Stumps around the pit are the seats, and ground litter, bark, moss and leaves fill the gaps while leaving 1 m walkways. You start on the east edge, looking west at the fire.

The focal point is a smoldering stone fire pit in the middle of the island (5,5.2). There's no tarp model, so the rain-shelter corner in the northwest is a tight stack of military and wooden crates with cans and jerrycans on top. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge and frames the scene. Around the fire are a mossy rock, a log stack for seating, a water bucket and scattered bark. The rest of the island is split into four areas: a barrel dump in the northeast, a supply cart on the west edge, a picnic table with small items in the southeast, and big mossy boulders on the south edge. Clear 1m walkways run between them and the fire, and the player starts at the south, looking north at the fire pit.

The focal point is a stone fire pit in the middle of the clearing at (5,5). A wooden bucket, a water pail and piles of dry branches sit close around it, and a fallen log to the south serves as a seat. A chain-link fence with a gate runs along the north edge. In front of it, from west to east, are a woodcutting zone with log stacks and axes, a tool corner with a pickaxe, broom, dustpan and trowel, and a third log stack. The picnic table with camp items and a barrel stove are on the east side, a small supply spot with buckets and a basket is on the west side, and dry rooibos bushes, dead quiver trunks and bark debris fill the corners. There are 1 m walkways all around the fire ring, and the player starts on the south edge looking north at the fire.

The stone fire pit sits at the center (5,5.5). A wooden bucket and a small pile of dry branches lie right beside it, and three fallen logs on the north, south and east sides serve as seats. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge. Firewood stacks and a dead tree fill the west edge, a tool corner is in the southwest, and a picnic table with a barrel stove and buckets fills the east side. Dry bushes and bark scraps line the edges, and there are 1 m walkways between the groups. You start on the southeast side, facing the fire.

The focal point is the folding outdoor table set in the centre at (5,5). It has a tea set and two thermoses on it, with chairs at its north and south ends. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge. In front of it are the cooking table with pot, pan and kettle in the northwest, and the coffee cart, a coffee table and a boombox side table in the northeast. The west edge holds a day bed with small side tables and a pile of firewood branches. The east side has a Chinese tea table with stools, a chalkboard and a ladder. The south edge has a picnic table and a small table with a radio. Walkways about 1m wide run around the centre, and the player spawns at the south edge looking north at the focal table.

The focal point is a stone fire pit at the island center (5,5). Three stump seats and a long fallen branch used as a bench ring the pit, and a timber stack sits beside it on the northeast with dry branches heaped on and against it. Mossy boulders frame the north edge, root clusters and a fallen trunk close off the west, south-west and east, and a rusty barrel stove stands near the south. Open walkways loop around the pit, and the spawn on the south edge looks north across the camp through the fog.

The island is a lantern-lit night market. The focal point is a central display table at x=5, z=5 holding three chess sets, ringed by glowing floor lanterns. Two stall counters line the north edge: a chess stall on the west side and a trinket and tea stall on the east, with a Chinese cabinet between them. The west edge has lantern shelves, a console table and a tea table. The east edge has sungka game tables and a chest. The south edge has painted Chinese screens, a chess game in progress on a tea table, a treasure chest and a price chalkboard. Walkways circle the centre table, and the player spawns on the open south walkway looking north at the chess display.

environment.sky: clear starry night sky with a warm festive glow

plan: The focal point is the stone fire pit at the island centre (5,5). Eight tree stump seats form a tight ring around it, several with brass diya lanterns on them, and glowing lanterns stand on the ground about 2 m out, with an open walking ring between them. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge and a big dead log serves as a bench along the south edge. Street lamps light the NW corner and the east edge. Four camp zones sit in the corners and along the west edge: a picnic table covered in lanterns and gear (NE), a day bed with a nightstand (W), a round lantern-lit table with stools (SW), and a generator, barrel stove and chopping stump with a hatchet and firewood (SE). The spawn point is at the north edge, looking south across the fire.

environment.sky: clear starry night sky with moon
environment.lighting: dark blue moonlight with warm orange firelight and lantern glow

plan: The focal point is a Chinese tea table in the center (5,5.2) with a chess set, candles, and two nightstand 'stools'. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the north edge, and two long vendor stalls stand in front of it selling chess sets and trinkets. A cabinet and a peacock screen close off the NE corner. Other groups: a chess-and-lantern table on the east side plus a checkout desk with a cash register; a west row of console tables with sungka boards, candles, and teaware, next to a cabinet and a screen; and a second chess table left of center. The south edge has small trinket desks, treasure chests, a chalkboard sign, and street lamps. A 1–2 m walkway runs north from the spawn point at the south edge to the center, then branches east and west between the stalls, and lanterns sit on nearly every surface.

environment.sky: clear starry night sky, deep blue
environment.mood: festive night market lit by lanterns and candles

plan: The smoldering stone fire pit at (5,5.5) is the focal point. Around it are a log-stack seat, a mossy rock seat and a picnic table with gear on top. There is no tarp model, so the covered stores are a dense row of crates, barrels and a storage cart along the north edge (z 0.2–2.2), with a barrel stove and fuel tucked against the west side. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the east edge in front of propane tanks, jerrycans and a woodpile, and mossy rocks line the south edge. A 1 m walkway loops around the fire, and the player spawns southwest looking at the fire.

The stone fire pit sits at the center (5,5) as the focal point. Eight tree stump seats form a tight ring around it, and eight glowing lanterns sit on the ground in a wider ring. A chainlink fence runs along the north edge and a fallen dead trunk frames the south edge, with ornate street lamps in the two southern corners. Four camp zones sit around a clear walkway about 1.5 m wide that circles the fire: a supply corner in the northwest (barrel stove, generator, firewood, a nightstand with torches), a picnic table covered in lanterns and a boombox in the northeast, a day bed with a bedside stand on the west edge, and a small round game table with two bar chairs on the east edge.

environment.sky: clear starry night sky with moonlight
environment.ground: forest floor with grass, dirt and fallen leaves

plan: The focal point is a cracked ceramic pot at the island's centre (5,5), ringed and overrun by nettles and weeds. A rusted chainlink fence runs along the north and east edges, with a latch gate in the southeast, and a tall mossy ruined fort wall closes off the south. Weathered planter boxes and potted plants line the west and north edges. Garden tools, a gnome and clay pots are clustered on the east side, and abandoned vases gather in the southeast corner. Open walkways about 1.5m wide circle the central pot, and a fallen branch lies across the ground.

environment.ground: overgrown weedy grass with patches of bare soil

plan: A cozy fenced garden nook: chain-link fence runs along the north and west edges. The focal point sits in the NW corner: a slatted rocking chair (the closest to a wicker chair) with a watering can at its side and periwinkle clumps around it, plus a basket and a trowel. Planter boxes, a hose and a compost bag line the north fence. A potting table with tools stands on the east edge, and a stone fire pit lounge with chairs and a sofa fills the south. A picnic table sits in the SW corner. Open lawn walkways cross the middle, and the player spawns on the east edge looking at the nook.

The focal point is the folding café table with two chairs at the island's centre (5,5). It holds the main tea set, two thermoses and a kettle, with a folding stool on each side. A chain-link fence runs along the north edge. In front of it is a camp kitchen line: a coffee cart, a prep table with pots and a pan, a radio table and a chalkboard. The west edge has a day bed, a leaning ladder and a pile of firewood. The east edge has a picnic table set for breakfast and a work table with a drill press. Along the south edge are tea and snack tables with stools. There is a walkway about 1.5 m wide around the centre table, and the player starts at the south, facing the focal table.

The focal point is a garden nook at (4,3): a rattan-style gallinera chair with a watering can beside it, surrounded by periwinkle, with a tall potted plant behind and a wicker basket nearby. A chainlink fence runs along the north and west edges. Planter boxes line the north fence, and a potting and compost corner sits along the west. A fire-pit lounge with a sofa, rocking chair and monobloc chair fills the south, and a picnic table plus a lounge chair corner fill the east. Open grass in the center (x 2–7, z 4–7) is the walkway linking all zones, and the spawn point looks from the west-center toward the nook.

The coffee cart sits in the middle of the north edge as the focal point, with three round bar stools in front of it and a side table and stool to its west. Architectural plinth pieces frame the NW and NE corners. Along the east edge, two bar tables each have a ring of bar stools. In the middle, a stone fire pit is ringed by monobloc chairs. The west edge has two outdoor bistro sets, and along the south edge a painted sofa with a marble coffee table sits next to a picnic table. Walkways run north to south at x≈2 and x≈7, and from east to west at z≈3. The player spawns in the SW, looking north toward the cart.

The focal point is an old ceramic pot in the middle of the island at (5,5), with nettles and weeds growing around it and over it. Rusted chainlink fences run along the north and east edges, and there is a gate on the east side. Weathered planter boxes full of nettles line the west edge, and a potting bench with tools stands in the NE corner. Compost bags are piled in the SE, and a row of pots, vases and a gnome runs along the south edge. A fallen branch, a sprinkler and scattered weeds and wildflowers fill the open ground, leaving a clear path from the south spawn point to the pot.

The focal point is the yellow sprinkler at the island centre (5,5), still running, in a lawn bed ringed by ferns and scattered with dandelions. Rusted chainlink fences run along the north and east edges. The north edge has a row of potted plants and pachira trees. The west edge has four raised planter boxes holding shrubs and garden tools. The east fence has a wall-mounted hose with a watering can below it. Clumps of anthurium and pachira fill the south corners. The south-centre strip stays open as the entry walkway, with a clear walkway around the fern ring.

The anthurium bed in the middle of the island is the focal point. It holds five anthurium clumps, and the gardener's seeding trays, trowel and gloves lie at the bed's south edge. Planter boxes frame the north, west and south edges. The north and west planters hold anthuriums and trays. The south row is a tool bench with saws, hammers and a drill. To the east there is a potting bench, potted plants, the hose and a hand truck. A second anthurium bed on the west side is separated by a walkway of about 1 m. You start in the southeast with open ground in front, looking northwest at the central bed.

The focal point is a central anthurium bed around (5,5). A gardener's kneeling spot sits on its north side, with gloves, a seedling tray and a trowel on the ground. Planter boxes line all four edges: seedling trays and anthurium starts sit on the north row, the east row is a potting bench with tools, and the west side holds the hose, hand truck and sledgehammer. A 1 m ring walkway circles the bed, and the south-center gap is left open for the spawn.

The running sprinkler sits at the centre (5,5) in a ring of ferns, low shrubs and dandelions scattered through wet grass. Planter boxes and terracotta pots line the north edge, with trowels, gloves and seedlings set on top. A chainlink fence runs along the east edge, with a wall hose, a watering can and more planters beside it. Pachira trees and anthuriums fill the west edge, and a few low plants frame the south. The player starts at the open middle of the south edge looking north at the sprinkler. There are 1 m walkways around the central bed.

plan: A 'busy morning cafe' island with a dark gothic coffee table at the center (5,5) as the focal point. Its top is piled with tea plates, cups and croissants. The service zone runs along the north edge: coffee cart, console, clock stand and a long gingham dining table set for breakfast. Smaller cafe tables with cups and pastries line the west, south and east edges, and two tea tables sit in the interior. Roughly 1 m walkways ring the center table, and the player spawns on the south side looking north at it.

The steaming coffee cart stands at the north-center edge as the focal point. Round bar chairs line up in front of it, with stools and a small round table on either side. Low raised apartment-facade plinths fill the NW and NE corners as terraces, with seating on top. The west edge holds a lounge (sofa, marble coffee table, monobloc chairs). The center and east have bar-table clusters and a bench, and the south has a picnic table, a fire pit and outdoor cafe sets. A clear walkway runs north-south down x≈5, and the player spawns on it facing the cart.

A sunny walled garden patio. A rusty chainlink fence frames the north and west edges, and heliophila-overflowing planter boxes line the north, west and east edges. The focal point is a stone fire pit at the center (5,5.2), with a painted wooden sofa north of it, a slatted bench to the west and a café table set to the east, flanked by large potted plants. A potting corner in the southeast holds planters, seedling trays and a sprinkler, and a clear 2 m walkway runs from the south edge (x 4–6) up to the fire pit, where the player spawns.

plan: The focal point is the closed coffee cart on the north edge. Two stacks of white monobloc chairs stand right beside it, with the chalkboard and a small bar-stool stack to the west and a tool cart in the NE corner. The middle of the island holds the cafe floor: two round tables and a painted table with chairs turned upside down on them, and a row of three folding outdoor table sets. Walkways run east-west at z≈5–6.4 and north-south between the tables. A rusty chainlink fence runs along the west edge. There is a lounge nook on the east edge, a wooden service counter with bar stools on the south edge, and a tea corner in the SW. The player spawns in the SE and looks north-west toward the cart.

The focal point is a gothic coffee table in the middle of the island, around (5,5), covered in Victorian tea plates, cups and croissants. Two coffee carts and a pastry counter line the north edge. The dining table sits on the east side, and a console table, a small outdoor table-and-chair set and side tables run along the west edge. Several smaller café tables with their own cups and pastries fill the south half. Walkways about 1 m wide run around the central table and to the south, where the player spawns at (3.7, 9.5) looking north-east at the focal table.

plan: The stone fire pit at (5,6) is the focal point. A modular bench to its north and the painted wooden sofa to its south both face it. A chain-link fence runs along the north and west edges. In front of the north fence is a row of six planter boxes overflowing with heliophila, and four tall planters with heliophila line the east edge. The west side has a potting area (planters with seedling trays) and a café table set. The south edge is dressed with big potted plants, a heliophila bed and gazania clumps. Walkways about 1 m wide loop around the fire pit, and spawn is on the open east side looking west at the pit.

A foggy dawn cafe terrace. The focal point is a small wooden table in the centre (5,5) with a lantern, candle and tea on it. A Chinese sofa sits behind it, with tall side tables and lamps on either side. Along the north edge are an arched cafe door with lanterns on both sides and two round bistro tables. The east edge has the service area: a coffee cart, a console table and a long pastry table with plates and cups. The west edge has two folding outdoor table sets. The south edge has a lantern-lit dining table, a tea table and a small table. Street lamps stand in all four corners to frame the space. Walkways about 1m wide circle the central group, and the player starts at the south-centre gap looking north at the glowing table.

plan: The focal point is a gothic coffee table in the middle of the island, with four mixed stools around it and a tea set on top. Two rows of glass pendant lamps hang above it, and a Chinese chandelier and a brass lantern add a festive glow. Around the edges are a coffee-cart station on the north, a sofa lounge on the west, bar tables with tall stools on the east, and a gingham dining table plus two outdoor café sets on the south. Four cast-iron street lamps frame the corners. Smaller table groups in the NW, NE, SW and SE fill the gaps, leaving walkways of about 1 m. The player starts on the east side, looking west at the lit coffee table.

The coffee cart is the focal point. It sits on the north edge, and two stacks of white monobloc chairs are packed tight beside it to the east. Two stacks of bar stools and a back-bar line of carts and nightstands run down the east edge. Chainlink fencing frames the north and west edges. The middle of the island is the cafe floor: rows of small tables, most with chairs put up on top for closing, plus a couple of chairs left out. A cozy lounge corner fills the south-east, and a bench and rocker line the south. Walkways run east–west at about z=2–3 and z=5, and a north–south aisle at x≈5.5–6.5 leads from the spawn point at the south edge to the cart.

plan: The focal point is a small wooden table in the centre of the square at (5,5). It holds a wooden lantern, a candlestick and a teacup on a plate, with a tiny side table next to it holding a brass lantern. The north edge is the service side: a coffee cart, a counter table and a console table, framed by tall street lamps in three corners. The player starts on the open south edge with a clear 3 m walkway north to the glowing centre table; side walkways about 1 m wide run between the groups.

A night garden framed by a rusted chainlink fence along the north edge, with a dense planting bed of dewy calatheas and anthuriums behind it. The focal point is a Victorian nightstand at the center (5,5) carrying a glowing oil lamp and hurricane lantern, ringed by glossy calathea clumps with a tall street lamp beside it. Lantern-lit side groups sit on the west and east edges (nightstands with lamps, gnomes, and plants), a softer planted corner is to the southwest, and a dry quiver-tree deadwood corner is to the southeast. A walkway runs up the middle from the south spawn, marked by two wooden path lanterns.

plan: The focal point is a gothic coffee table at the centre of the island (5,5). plan: A rainy-evening cafe terrace. The focal point is a castle-style cafe door on the north edge with a folding awning above it. Under the awning stand a large round wooden table and three stools, with the lidded ceramic pot (standing in for the teapot), cups, plates and a jug on the table. A coffee cart sits against the west edge, two outdoor table-and-chair sets line the east edge, a lounge table with stools is on the mid-west side, and a small industrial table group and a Chinese tea table are mid-east. plan: The cafe's arched castle door sits at the center of the north edge, flanked by potted plants, with two folding awnings mounted above the terrace. The focal point is a round wooden table with a ceramic teapot, cups and bar stools under the main awning, and a small folding table-and-chairs set sits under the second awning. Around them are a coffee cart and corner plants on the north edge, a picnic table and side table on the east, a larger round table group in the center-south, a gothic tea table lounge in the southwest, a plant display on the west edge, and a gingham dining table on the south edge. Walkways of about 1 m run between the groups, and the player spawns in the south-center looking north at the teapot table.

The focal point is a lounge group in the middle of the patio. A slatted wooden rocking chair stands in for the wicker chair, since there is no wicker chair model, and it has throw pillows piled on it. It faces a turquoise coffee table, a leather sofa and two armchairs. A coffee cart with bar stools and benches lines the north edge between chainlink fence corners. Cafe table sets and small tables fill the west side, a picnic table and a Chinese sofa corner fill the east, and a sofa nook with another cafe set runs along the south. About 1 m of open walkway rings the central lounge, and small baskets and pillows sit on the tables and seats.

A sunny cafe patio. A coffee cart, bar stools and a chainlink fence corner frame the north edge, and five folding cafe table sets fill the east half in two rows, with a sofa lounge on the east edge. A day bed, bench, small sofa and picnic table line the south edge, and an open east–west walkway at z≈4.6 runs from the spawn to the focal nook.

plan: The focal point is a planted bed in the middle of the island. Rusted chainlink fences run along the north, west and east edges. Plant beds line the fences, and three lantern-lit nightstand spots sit in the NE, west and SW.
